run_compile_deep_gemm_kernels: run DeepGEMM kernel compilation for a model with server arguments like --model and --tp
create_CompileArgs_timeout: create CompileArgs dataclass with a configurable timeout for kernel compilation
refine_server_args_for_compilation: refine server args to disable CUDA graph and torch compile and set watchdog timeout for DeepGEMM compilation
launch_server_process_for_deep_gemm: launch a server process and send a health-check request to trigger DeepGEMM kernel compilation
warm_up_compile_deep_gemm: warm up the server by sending a generate request to capture DeepGEMM calls during compilation
